readme.run: Stitch a grid or collection of microscopy TIFF tiles into a blended mosaic
notes: Input is a folder of TIFF tiles (and optional TileConfiguration.txt) or 2+ TIFF files.
Choose --layout grid, file, or stage (auto-detected by default). Add --help for options.
Writes <stem>_stitched.tif, TileConfiguration.registered.txt, pairs CSV and provenance JSON.
No network connection is required and no external model files are downloaded.
For OME-Zarr (.ozx) conversion, use the web app or omezarr-convert.
